label: Unverified
description: Identity asserted by the applicant only.

label: Verified
description: Identity verified against an authoritative source.

label: Provisional
description: Temporarily accepted identity pending registry confirmation.

label: Disputed
description: Conflicting identity evidence; licensing actions blocked.

label: Merged
description: Superseded by a surviving entity record.

label: Legacy known
description: Locally known record migrated from the pre-entity architecture. No external verification provenance is claimed.
